title: Local Storage Service State
description: Reads key–value pairs from the browser's `localStorage` and emits them as an array. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/local-storage)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

filter.description: Key prefix filter. Only keys starting with this string are included. Empty string = all keys.

process.description: When true, immediately fires the current item list downstream via app.next()
